title: Point Mugu missile base near Oxnard

tellings.quote: military base there that near there that was very important at one time. Point Magcoo.

plain: A military base called Point Mugu, near the town of Oxnard in California, was once a very important place, according to Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects he believes are alien implants in human bodies. Colbern mentions the base in passing while talking with Michels, from his own knowledge of the area, and names no source.
